_comment: SYNTHETIC FIXTURE - not a recording of any site.
Reproduces the shape of GET /v1/app/init that listing.go reads:
payload.results.comic_genres[], each entry carrying a numeric id, a name
and an is_active flag. The real response also carries dozens of other
bootstrap tables (currencies, countries, sort orders, ...); only
comic_genres is declared in api.go because nothing here reads the rest.
Why synthetic: PLAN section 1.3 forbids this repository from containing
anything that functions as a catalogue of sources, and section 1.4 forbids
copying others' expression. The response shape (the comic_genres array and
its id/name/is_active fields) is a fact observed live against the real API
on 2026-09-24; the genre names and ids here are a small invented sample.
Deliberate variations exercised by the test:
- the third genre has is_active: 0 and must be skipped
- genres are listed out of alphabetical order, so a test can tell
Listings() is not silently re-sorting them
